editorial:
Imagine being a rodeo clown who can't speak and spends his nights having scary, dark dreams. That is exactly where you find yourself with the main character in this gritty crime story. You get a look into the lonely life of an aging man who feels trapped between his weird nightmares and the harsh world he lives in. The movie has a very heavy, moody feel to it that makes you wonder what is actually real and what is just in his head. It is not your typical action movie; it is more of a slow burn that pulls you into a strange, uncomfortable place.

What really works here is the acting, since the lead has to tell the whole story without saying a single word. You will notice that the pacing is a bit slow, but that helps build the tension before things get messy. If you like movies that feel like a puzzle, you will enjoy trying to piece together his past. You should definitely try to find this on 4K Ultra HD if you can, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great call because the dark colors look amazing on a big screen.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that the scary dreams were actually memories of a crime. The main character finally faces the truth about the violence in his past. He realizes he cannot run away from what he did, and the line between his sleep and his awake life disappears. It ends with a sad realization that his silence was a way to hide from his guilt, leaving him trapped in his own mind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and weird character studies.
